vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: adopt-a-caracal
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle provides instructions and API documentation for interacting with a virtual pet simulation on animalhouse.ai. It uses standard REST API calls (via curl) for registration, adoption, and pet maintenance (feeding, playing) without any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized execution. The instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose of managing a virtual Caracal.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only adapter for animalhouse.ai virtual-pet endpoints; its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose and request no unrelated privileges or credentials.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the runtime instructions: all calls target animalhouse.ai to register, adopt, check status, and perform care actions. Nothing asked for is out of scope for a virtual-pet integration.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only contains curl examples and API semantics for animalhouse.ai endpoints. It does not instruct the agent to read local files, other environment variables, or exfiltrate data to unrelated endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only skill. This minimizes on-disk risk and no packages or downloads are requested.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or platform credentials. It uses a per-user bearer token returned by the service (documented in the instructions), which is appropriate for API access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but the skill does not request elevated or persistent system privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk, but it will cause your agent to make network requests to https://animalhouse.ai and to handle the bearer token returned at registration. Before installing: (1) confirm you trust the animalhouse.ai domain and review its privacy/terms, (2) treat the registration token as a secret — store it securely and do not paste sensitive credentials into username/display_name fields, (3) if you stop using the service, revoke or rotate the token if the site offers that, and (4) monitor network activity if you have concerns about data sent to the external API.
